title: Release quest-cli 0.3.3
description: User-approved (2026-09-05, AskUserQuestion) to unblock opum-agent and opum-doc's 'agents --check --require-installed' CI, which stays broken until a release carries QCLI-227's --target flag. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md and the QCLI-166/QCLI-224 precedent exactly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Root package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, optionalDependencies, and the conformance fixture bumped to 0.3.3 and committed together with freshly-built (Bun 1.3.14) platform packages so check:packages passes on first CI attempt
v0.3.3 tag pushed and prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against it; native-execution receipt downloaded and bun run receipt:require passes

release.yml dispatched with publish=false (dry run) then publish=true against v0.3.3, gated on the receipt - publish=true is the one step requiring the repo's own user's direct, immediate go-ahead, not an earlier general approval
Post-publish clean-install smoke (version, manifest, task op, and the new --target claude flag) passes against the published registry artifacts
bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the six published platform tarballs
docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md gets a new dated section for 0.3.3

Release notes state this adds --target claude|codex to quest agents and quest init --agent-instructions (QCLI-227), fixing opum-agent/opum-doc's agents --check --require-installed once they update to it, with a same-release fix so the claude-target block's own CI hint names --target claude instead of the codex-target command (QCLI-231); the codex/AGENTS.md default is unchanged for existing callers

implementationNotes: AC1: bumped package.json (version, optionalDependencies), src/application/version.ts (QUEST_VERSION), src/contract/tracker/index.ts (QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION), fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json (questVersion) all to 0.3.3. Repo-wide grep confirmed no other hand-edited 0.3.2 references remained outside .quest/ task history and generated npm/quest-* manifests. Rebuilt all six platform binaries with the pinned Bun 1.3.14 (matches package.json's packageManager exactly - checked before touching anything) via bun run build:packages, which also regenerated questPlatformPackages' checksums. bun run check:packages and bun run test:packages both exit 0. Regenerated CLAUDE.md's managed block via the from-source CLI (agents --update-instructions --target claude) rather than hand-editing it - confirms it correctly now reads 'Quest CLI 0.3.3' and 'quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude' (QCLI-231's fix). Full bun run check green: 403/403 tests.
